messages.content: Best practices for this file: Project uses DaisyUI for components, use them instead basic HTML elements # Vue vuejs coding best pratices Vue files must always follow this structure in this order. No other elements are valid: ```example vue file

<script setup>
</script>
<template>
  <select class="select" v-model="selectedModel">
    <option v-for="model in models" :key="model.id" :value="model.name">
      {{ model.name }}
    </option>
  </select>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      selectedModel: this.models.length ? this.models[0].name : ''
    }
  },
  computed: {
    models() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings.ai_models
    }
  },
  watch: {
    selectedModel(newModel) {
      this.$emit('update:model', newModel)
    }
  }
}
</script>
